property_summary: For any clone created by the factory, the return value of the public pure getter collateral() must equal the collateral token address stored in the immutable args at offset 0x14, not the owner address at offset 0x0; the bug returns the owner address instead.
change_summary: Change the returned ERC20 address from _getArgAddress(0x14) to _getArgAddress(0x0) so that collateral() returns the owner address cast to ERC20.
